summary: Differential endpoint activity audit export with provenance checksums for compliance review
description: Issue summary: Customer requests a narrowly-scoped differential export of endpoint activity (API call metadata and delivery traces) covering a 72-hour window for a subset of tenant IDs. They require per-record provenance checksums, field-level lineage (which service produced each field), and a PII-redaction manifest for legal review. This is for a healthcare compliance assessment and must be delivered as verifiable artifacts.
impact: Customer cannot complete an internal compliance assessment and respond to regulator questionnaires without the export. Timebox: 72-hour window export. Business impact: regulatory deadline in 7 days.
request_details: Requested export parameters provided by customer: time_range=2026-03-03T00:00:00Z..2026-03-06T00:00:00Z, tenant_ids=[stc-23, stc-57], include_fields=[request_id,timestamp,route,model,region,client_ip,auth_subject,request_body_hash,response_status], provenance=true (service:field map), checksum_alg=sha256, redaction_policy=pii-strict (mask emails, IP last octet), delivery=encrypted-s3 presigned URL, manifest=ndjson with per-file checksum and resume_token. They also asked for an audit of any missed events (gap detection) and a signed cover letter enumerating processing steps.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer submitted evidence request form via support portal with required parameters and SLA flag.
2) Support validated request params and escalated to export team for feasibility and data retention window check.
3) Export worker ran a dry-run query against prod audit index to estimate size and checked redaction macros.
4) Identified mismatches in field lineage tags for some legacy routes and flagged for engineering review.
logs: export-worker: dry-run returned 12,742 records estimated; query id q-20260310-7f2
audit-service: lineage tag missing for route /v1/legacy/predict in ~0.9% of events (sample ids: r-ff12, r-ff32)
s3-archive: latest retention checkpoint OK; bucket redwood-exports-prod accessible from export-worker role
investigation_notes: Support: verified retention window covers requested dates (retention 90 days).
SRE: export-worker can produce differential delta via seq_id deltas; estimated uncompressed payload 24MB per tenant.

Eng (audit-service): discovered that legacy route /v1/legacy/predict omitted 'producer_service' tag between 2026-03-04T02:00Z and 2026-03-04T04:30Z due to a prior logging rollout (incubator-logging v2).

Hypothesis: missing lineage tags are confined to that time slice and affect ~110 records per tenant; checksums can still be computed from canonical serialized record, but provenance field will be populated as 'unknown:legacy-logging' in manifest pending remediation.
workaround: Proceed with export including a manifest entry that marks affected records with producer_service=unknown:legacy-logging and attach the dry-run sample list for customer review. Provide checksum per record so external verification is possible. Offer to re-run export if engineering backfills lineage tags.
resolution_notes: In progress: agreed to produce the export with following caveats: (a) affected records marked in manifest, (b) redaction applied per pii-strict, (c) deliver encrypted tarball to presigned S3 link and include signed manifest (sha256 over manifest file). Engineering to schedule a follow-up backfill job and reopen a separate ticket if customer requests a lineage-corrected export.
